notes:
Summary: Saltway piloted Hosted API in Q4 2025 for embeddings + chat. Good dev velocity, but hit variability in latency under bursty load. Now moved to Dedicated procurement discussions.
- Q4 POC: 2M tokens across 3 endpoints (user assist, search rerank, summarization).
- Key ask: predictable p95 latency <=200ms for chat, sustained throughput 50 req/s with 4k token average, and ability to burst to 200 req/s for 10 min windows.
- Security: strict SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs retention 1y, and EU data residency for multi-tenant customers.
- Pricing focus: want committed GPU-hours with burst pool, transparent overage formula, and ramp discount schedule.
- Quote from CTO (M. Alvarez): "We need a billing model that scales with usage but doesn't blow up in month 1. Predictability beats cheapest per-token rate."
- POC learnings: prefix KV caching in hosted reduced avg tokens by 18% but tail latency variability remained during concurrent batch jobs. Dedicated expected to reduce variance and provide guaranteed throughput.

requirements_summary: Workloads: chat (latency-sensitive), embeddings (high QPS for search), reranking (batch/rerank pipelines). Latency SLO: p95 <=200ms for chat; throughput target 50 sustained req/s, 200 burst. Data controls: VPC private control plane, SSO, KMS, audit logging, EU data residency. Ops: need canary rollouts, per-route tracing, token-level cost reports. Model preferences: open models with quantization support; fallback to smaller family in capacity shortage.
price_negotiation_notes: Initial sticker: $0.28/token equivalent (hosted) — not acceptable for predictable budget.
Redwood proposed Dedicated bands: Commit 4k GPU-hours/mo => 35% discount; 8k GPU-hours/mo => 50% discount.
Saltway counter: wants a 6k starting commit for first 3 months with step-up schedule to 10k by month 6.
Suggested ramp schedule: months 1-3 at 6k, months 4-6 at 8k, months 7+ at 10k. Redwood to provide guaranteed burst pool of 2x baseline for up to 15 minutes/day.
Overage: Redwood proposed overage at 1.4x unit price; Saltway pushing for 1.25x with monthly cap.
Billing cadence: monthly invoicing with carry-forward credits for unused committed hours (90-day expiry).
Enterprise add-ons: 24/7 support and extended SLA for an additional fixed fee; Saltway evaluating need.
poC_details: Hosted API POC covered functional validation and quality metrics; Dedicated POC plan includes capacity test (sustained 72-hour soak), failover simulation, and deploy/rollback rehearsals. SE to provision identical model/quantization profile in dedicated pool and run two parallel stress tests (search and chat) with tracing enabled.
